column3: The BioMed MIT Portfolio Mortgage Loan (8.3%), for which JPMorgan Chase Bank, National Association, Societe Generale Financial Corporation and Goldman Sachs Mortgage Company are the mortgage loan sellers, is part of a Whole Loan that was co-originated by Goldman Sachs Bank USA, Citi Real Estate Funding Inc., Deutsche Bank AG, New York Branch, JPMorgan Chase Bank, National Association and Societe Generale Financial Corporation.
